<content>
1: // Simple arcade game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Audio setup
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
12:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + dur);
20:     osc.start(now);
21:     osc.stop(now + dur);
22:   }
23:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
24:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
25: 
26:   // Canvas size and resize handling
27:   function resize() {
28:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
29:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
30:     initStars();
31:   }
32:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
33:   resize();
34: 
35:   // Starfield background
36:   let stars = [];
37:   const starCount = 100;
38:   function initStars() {
39:     stars = [];
40:     for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
41:       stars.push({
42:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
43:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
44:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
45:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
46:       });
47:     }
48:   }
49:   function drawStars() {
50:     ctx.save();
51:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
52:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
53:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
54:     stars.forEach(s => {
55:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
56:       ctx.beginPath();
57:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
58:       ctx.fill();
59:     });
60:     ctx.restore();
61:   }
62: 
63:   // Ship (triangle)
64:   const ship = {
65:     width: 40,
66:     height: 20,
67:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
68:     y: canvas.height - 30,
69:     speed: 5,
70:     dx: 0,
71:     draw() {
72:       ctx.save();
73:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
74:       ctx.beginPath();
75:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height);
76:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y);
77:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
78:       ctx.closePath();
79:       ctx.fill();
80:       ctx.restore();
81:     },
82:     update() {
83:       this.x += this.dx;
84:       if (this.x < 0) this.x = 0;
85:       if (this.x + this.width > canvas.width) this.x = canvas.width - this.width;
86:     },
87:   };
88: 
89:   // Input handling
90:   const keys = {};
91:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
92:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
93: 
94:   function handleInput() {
95:     ship.dx = 0;
96:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
97:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.dx = ship.speed;
98:   }
99: 
100:   // Debris
101:   const debris = [];
102:   const debrisSize = 20;
103:   const spawnInterval = 1000;
104:   let lastSpawn = 0;
105: 
106:   function spawnDebris() {
107:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - debrisSize);
108:     debris.push({ x, y: -debrisSize, size: debrisSize, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 3 });
109:   }
110: 
111:   function updateDebris() {
112:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
113:       const d = debris[i];
114:       d.y += d.speed;
115:       if (d.y > canvas.height) debris.splice(i, 1);
116:     }
117:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
118:       spawnDebris();
119:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
120:     }
121:   }
122: 
123:   function drawDebris() {
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
125:     debris.forEach(d => ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.size, d.size));
126:   }
127: 
128:   // Collision detection
129:   function checkCollision() {
130:     return debris.some(d =>
131:       ship.x < d.x + d.size &&
132:       ship.x + ship.width > d.x &&
133:       ship.y < d.y + d.size &&
134:       ship.y + ship.height > d.y
135:     );
136:   }
137: 
138:   // Score
139:   const startTime = Date.now();
140:   let gameOver = false;
141: 
142:   function drawScore() {
143:     const seconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000);
144:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
145:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
146:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${seconds}s`, 10, 30);
147:   }
148: 
149:   // Main loop
150:   function loop() {
151:     if (gameOver) return;
152:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
153:     drawStars();
154: 
155:     handleInput();
156:     ship.update();
157:     ship.draw();
158: 
159:     updateDebris();
160:     drawDebris();
161: 
162:     drawScore();
163: 
164:     if (checkCollision()) {
165:       playTone(200, 0.2); // collision sound
166:       gameOver = true;
167:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
168:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
169:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
170:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
171:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
172:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
173:     } else {
174:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175:     }
176:   }
177: 
178:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
179: })();

(End of file - total 179 lines)
